repos_data.description: The first MCP server for sports betting — 9 tools, live odds, AI picks, 59.6% win rate across 1,353+ picks

Unified MCP server — 41 sports API providers, 396 tools in one process: scores, stats, odds, esports, F1/MotoGP/NASCAR, EuroLeague, chess, AFL, boxing & more across 70+ sports. 19 work with no API key.
MCP server for the Flash Props API: player props, normalized markets, line movement, and projections across sports and esports, in Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Free tier, no scraping.
An MCP Server implementation that integrates the Balldontlie API, to provide information about players, teams and games for the NBA, NFL and MLB
MCP server exposing the free SportScore sports-data API as tool calls for Claude, Cursor, and Zed. Live scores, fixtures, standings for football, basketball, cricket, tennis.
This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides professional cycling data from FirstCycling. It allows you to retrieve information about professional cyclists, race results, and more.
A simple minimal weather mcp server :)
The implementation of Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for VictoriaLogs.

Free, open-source sports-data MCP server — 841 tools across 64 providers: cross-book betting odds, official league stats, racing, fantasy, cricket, F1 and more. 44 providers need no key. Now also places bets at four Australian books. Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides comprehensive access to MLB statistics and baseball data through a FastMCP-based interface.

A Model Context Protocol server for Chess.com's Published Data API.  This provides access to Chess.com player data, game records, and other public information through standardized MCP interfaces, allowing AI assistants to search and analyze chess information.
